newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka blue chips rise on gowth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka blue chips rise on gowth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lankan blue chips rose sharply in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
John Keells Holdings Ltd was 1.5 percent or 4.75 rupees up to 315, National Development Bank Ltd 3.85 percent or 10 rupees to 270.
"Both shares are rising as they are expected to see good profit growth in the current financial year," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of brokerage John Keells.
John Keells Holdings is a diversified conglomerate. National Development Bank is one of two blue chip development finance institutions listed in Colombo. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
